'''19,000 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] ([[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]])''' was a year in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]. The era, having begun [[20,000 BBY/Legends|1,000 years earlier]], featured rapid expansion out from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and into the areas of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Located on the thick disk of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the isolated [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] underwent a dramatic climate change. There, the surface [[Water/Legends|ice]] began to melt and flood the planet, forcing the [[Kaminoan/Legends|native]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to relocate their [[City/Legends|cities]].

==Proem==
In the years prior to 19,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] was a terrestrial world on the thick disk that featured only small narrow [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Landlocked, the oceans were overpopulated with [[Eel/Legends|eels]] and [[Cetacean/Legends|cetaceans]] that choked the [[Water/Legends|waters]]. On land, small marshes and low-lying areas had given rise to the tall, sleek [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The natives developed [[City/Legends|cities]] along the oceanic coastal areas, such as the community [[Derem City|Derem]].<ref name="EA" />

==The galaxy in 19,000 BBY==
Around the year 19,000 BBY, Kamino began a dramatic climate shift. The surface ice, which was confined to the planetary glaciers, began to melt. As it melted, the low-lying marshes that gave rise to the Kaminoans and the narrow oceans began to flood, covering the then-extant land area. Elsewhere, in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] was continuing. The Republic continued its expansion and settlement of the areas east of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], into the area that eventually came to be known as "[[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]."<ref name="EA" />

==Impact==
Within two centuries, all the surface land on Kamino was buried under water, which was hundreds of meters deep at places. The former cities, such as Derem, and architectural wonders, such as the [[Clock Spires of Harai Nova]], were submerged. For survival, the Kaminoans adapted the technology they possessed to build their cities on stilts above the water level. Furthermore, the Kaminoans turned to genetic engineering to preserve many of the species that drowned in the rising waters. In the broader Republic, the expansion of the Great Manifest Period continued for another [[17,000 BBY|2,000 years]], until the rival Core Worlds [[First Alsakan Conflict|began]] a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series of conflicts]] for supremacy.<ref name="EA" />

==Notable events==
*Kamino's glaciers began to melt due to climate change.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The year 19,000 BBY receives its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', published in [[2009]].<ref name="EA" /> While the Great Manifest Period is outlined in other sources, such as ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the year 19,000 BBY is not specifically mentioned.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> In the ''Atlas'', the year is specifically mentioned in the discussion of the planet Kamino, where the detailing of the planet's climactic shift is documented. Elsewhere in the ''Atlas'', the year is merely alluded to in discussion of the Great Manifest Period.<ref name="EA" />
